translations.asad: In the name of God, The Most Gracious, The Dispenser of Grace:
translations.sahih: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

translations.asad: All praise is due to God alone, the Sustainer of all the worlds,
translations.sahih: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

translations.asad: The Most Gracious, the Dispenser of Grace,
translations.sahih: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

translations.asad: Lord of the Day of Judgment!
translations.sahih: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

translations.asad: Thee alone do we worship; and unto Thee alone do we turn for aid.
translations.sahih: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path -

text.arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translations.asad: The way of those upon whom Thou hast bestowed Thy blessings, not of those who have been condemned [by Thee], nor of those who go astray!
translations.sahih: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
